messages:
maria_sales: Quick heads-up — FinRegCo requested itemized evidence for SIG encryption questions (rest + in-transit + KMS rotation). Can we pull together artifacts today? They want per-question mapping.

raj_security: OK. Which SIG question IDs are they asking about? Usually encryption maps to 3.1 (encryption at rest), 3.2 (encryption in transit), 3.3 (key management/rotation). Need: KMS policy doc, rotation history/audit logs, storage config (S3/GCS bucket settings), TLS cert chain proof.

olivia_pse: I can coordinate with the POC. Quick clarify: do they need raw logs or redacted screenshots/exports? Also: do we send a vendor attestation or just artifacts?

raj_security: Prefer machine-readable artifacts where possible (CloudTrail/Audit logs). If raw IDs contain customer PII we must redact. Acceptable items:
- policy doc (PDF)
- CloudTrail/Stackdriver export snippets (last 12 months)
- S3/GCS bucket policy JSON
- TLS cert chain PEM files or cert transparency entries
- short signed attestation (1 page)

dan_devrel: We have a sample KMS rotation policy and a script to pull rotation events. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/kms-rotation (internal)
Example AWS command to pull rotation events:
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=DisableKeyRotation --start-time 2024-03-01 --end-time 2025-03-01 --region us-west-2
```
For key rotation there are also DescribeKey and ListKeyPolicies calls; for showing usage you can grab ReEncrypt/GenerateDataKey events in CloudTrail.

sec-bot: New ticket created: INC-2026 - SIG evidence request for FinRegCo. Assigned: raj_security. SLA: 48h. https://issues.redwood.ai/INC-2026

maria_sales: Thanks — timeline is EOD tomorrow. Customer prefers a single ZIP with an index mapping question->artifact. Also they asked if we can note which artifacts are redacted.

raj_security: Good idea. Use a simple index.csv with columns: question_id,artifact_filename,artifact_type,redaction_notes. Example:
```csv
question,filename,type,notes
3.1,kms_policy_v1.pdf,policy,none
3.3/rotation,cloudtrail_rotation_2024-01-01-2025.json,audit-log,redacted IAM user ids
```

olivia_pse: For redaction policy: remove full ARNs for customer-managed resources but keep sanitized role names. Eg turn `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodService` -> `arn:aws:iam::<REDACTED_ACCOUNT>:role/RedwoodService`. Raj, can you confirm?

raj_security: Yup — redact account numbers and any customer-identifying IDs. Keep role names and timestamps. For CloudTrail exports, replace account IDs with `<REDACTED_ACCOUNT>` and remove IP addresses if they map to customer infra.

dan_devrel: Attestation template (short) — put this at top-level of zip: attestation_finregco.txt. Sample text snippet: "Redwood Inference confirms the following controls are in place for the hosted environment used by FinRegCo: encryption at rest with customer-managed keys, TLS 1.2+ in transit, and automated KMS rotation; see attached artifacts." Link to template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/attestation-templates

maria_sales: Perfect. Who will assemble the zip? I can upload to the SFDC opportunity, but need files by 5pm PST tomorrow.

raj_security: I'll grab the policy PDFs and rotation logs. Dan — can you export the bucket policy JSONs and cert PEMs? Olivia — please double-check the index.csv and run quick review for redaction.

dan_devrel: On it — will post artifacts to a secure internal share and ping you when ready. Example path we'll use: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/finregco/1788887654/ (access controlled).

sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: auto-check in 23 hours for INC-2026.

maria_sales: Thanks team — I'll set expectation with the customer that delivery will include a redaction summary and the attestation. :thumbsup:

raj_security: One more note: for rotation proof, customer accepts either CloudTrail entries or an exported KMS key metadata table showing rotationEnabled=true and lastRotated timestamp. We'll provide both.

maria_sales: Great — closing the loop. I'll update the opportunity and attach the INC link.
